destination._comment_vat: Israel standard VAT is 18% as of 2025.
destination._comment_tiers: Israel de-minimis: <$75 exempt; $75-$500 VAT only; >$500 VAT + customs. Tiers compared on (item+shipping) value in USD.

_comment_il_shipping: il_shipping values: 'unconfirmed_verify_at_checkout' = ships internationally but Israel not confirmed (could not reach checkout from here); 'verified_no_direct' = store confirmed it does NOT ship to Israel (forwarder required); 'via_forwarder' = domestic-only store, reach Israel through a forwarder below. ships_to_israel = can the shoe reach Israel at all (direct or via forwarder); shipping_cost includes the forwarder leg where one is needed.

retailers.name: Brooks Israel (official importer) — DOMESTIC
retailers.notes: Official Brooks importer IN Israel -> domestic delivery, no customs/forwarder. 4E unlikely on the shelf (Israel stocks standard D width), BUT ask them to SPECIAL-ORDER the 4E/EU43 from Brooks distribution. Best no-forwarder option. Also try Run-Way (run-way.co.il), Mashbir 365, R.A.N Sport. shipping_cost is local courier in ILS.

retailers.name: Run and Become (UK)
retailers.notes: 4E CONFIRMED in stock (explicit SKU). VERIFIED (user) does NOT ship to Israel -> route via forward2me UK hub. shipping_cost includes the forwarder leg. Best UK source to BUY the 4E; just needs a forwarder.

retailers.name: SportsShoes.com (UK)
retailers.notes: Ships outside the EU; brand partners may restrict non-EU shipping and Israel is not confirmed - verify at checkout. Confirm 4E + EU43 (EU stock often only 2E). Else forward2me UK hub.

retailers.notes: 4E CONFIRMED. US-only store -> reach Israel via Qwintry or Meest (US->IL, documented). shipping_cost includes forwarder leg.

retailers.name: =PR= Run & Walk (US)
retailers.notes: 4E CONFIRMED. US-only -> Qwintry/Meest forwarder to Israel. shipping_cost includes forwarder leg.

retailers.name: Holabird Sports (US)

retailers.name: Brooks UK (official)

retailers.name: Profeet.co.uk (UK)
retailers.notes: Dedicated 4E Wide page. Israel shipping not confirmed; assume forward2me UK hub. shipping_cost includes forwarder leg.

retailers.name: Amazon (US/UK/DE/ES/IT/FR)
retailers.notes: Checked ALL marketplaces: AmazonGlobal export to Israel covers ONLY items shipped+sold by Amazon itself; THIRD-PARTY sellers are excluded. The 4E is always a 3rd-party listing -> no Amazon marketplace ships the 4E to Israel (this is why amazon.es failed). Exception to watch: a 4E/9.5 variant marked 'Ships from and Sold by Amazon' with a 'Deliver to Israel' option. Otherwise reach IL via forwarder.
